messages:
Priya (DevEx): heads up — docs CI failed after the docusaurus upgrade, linkcheck is flagging a broken fragment on /guides/deploy -> tried /guides/deploy#autoscale but the anchor doesn't exist :thinking_face:
BuildBot: CI | docs-site build • FAILED
BuildBot: 
ERROR: LinkCheck: Broken fragment: /guides/deploy -> #autoscale (404)
BuildBot: Full log: https://ci.internal/redwood/docs/98765
Maria (Docs): ugh, that anchor used to be generated from the H2 'Autoscaling' — maybe slug rules changed in the new plugin
Jon (Eng): I saw this locally too. Docusaurus now strips punctuation and lowercases differently. The heading was "Autoscaling (SLOs)" -> used to be #autoscaling-slos now it's #autoscaling-slos-? not sure
Lina (Docs): can someone paste the heading text from the MD file? I can add an explicit id if needed
Alex (Tech Writer): file: docs/guides/deploying.md — heading currently: 
```
## Autoscaling & SLOs
```
Alex (Tech Writer): so the & is probably being converted to "-and-" or removed entirely depending on slugify mode
Priya (DevEx): quick mitigation: add a redirect/fragments rule for the old anchor, and open a tiny docs PR to add an explicit HTML id on the heading so it survives future slug changes
Jon (Eng): agree. I'll open a PR with both: a redirect entry in docusaurus config and add an explicit id. PR will be small.
Jon (Eng): patch snippet I'll push: 
```md
## Autoscaling & SLOs {#autoscaling-slos}
```
Jon (Eng): and in docusaurus.config.js redirect plugin: 
```js
module.exports = {
  plugins: [
    ['@docusaurus/plugin-client-redirects', {
      redirects: [
        { to: '/guides/deploying#autoscaling-slos', from: ['/guides/deploy#autoscale'] }
      ]
    }]
  ]
}
```
Maria (Docs): perfect. Also can we add a unit test in our linkcheck CI job to catch this mapping? maybe add a small map that verifies old -> new anchors exist
Priya (DevEx): yes I'll add a guard in CI that treats these redirects as allowed so the linkcheck passes after the redirect is added, then we can tighten later
Lina (Docs): @Jon can you also update the example snippet in the "deploying" guide that points at the anchor? one spot in the SRE checklist references the old fragment
Jon (Eng): on it. will push all three changes in one PR: heading id, redirect config, update the checklist link. link: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/1298 (draft)
Alex (Tech Writer): leaving a comment in the PR to explain why explicit ids are being added (slugify changes in docusaurus v3)
BuildBot: CI | docs-site build • rerun queued
Maria (Docs): once CI green, can we backfill a short note in the migration guide: "Docusaurus v3 slug changes may alter fragment ids — prefer explicit ids for critical anchors"
Priya (DevEx): good call. I'll add a short section to docs/migration/docusaurus_v3.md
Lina (Docs): looks good. thanks all :thumbsup:
Jon (Eng): done — PR updated, CI is running. ping here when green and I'll merge
Maria (Docs): also added a quick test to the linkcheck job that asserts redirects exist before failing; reduces flakiness for known legacy fragments
Priya (DevEx): awesome. closing the loop here — followups: 1) merge PR 1298, 2) post migration note, 3) audit top 10 high-traffic anchors for explicit ids
Alex (Tech Writer): happy to help run the audit and open PRs for docs I own
Lina (Docs): thanks team, leaving this thread.
